title.original: PACT: Privileged Trace Co-Training for Multi-Turn Tool-Use Agents
title.zh: PACT：面向多轮工具使用智能体的特权轨迹协同训练
title.en: PACT: Privileged Trace Co-Training for Multi-Turn Tool-Use Agents

inclusion_reason.zh: PACT 给出可复用的纯提示 rollout、特权轨迹双目标优化和锚定训练框架，而非仅报告一个工具模型结果。
inclusion_reason.en: PACT contributes a reusable training framework for prompt-only rollouts, dual privileged-trace objectives, and anchoring rather than only a tool-model result.

abstract.zh: PACT 以特权专家轨迹共同训练多轮工具 Agent：rollout 仍只看提示，轨迹只在优化阶段提供 RL 评估和组件级监督信号。
abstract.en: PACT co-trains multi-turn tool agents with privileged expert traces while keeping rollouts prompt-only; traces influence optimization through RL evaluation and component-level supervision.

problem.zh: 稀疏奖励 RL 难分配多轮信用，直接对专家轨迹做 SFT 又会把 Agent 锁定在固定路径并造成推理分布偏移。
problem.en: Sparse-reward RL has weak multi-turn credit assignment, whereas direct expert-trace SFT can lock agents into fixed paths and shift the inference distribution.

approach.zh: 框架用轨迹条件 RL surrogate 评价纯提示 rollout，以退火的组件 SFT 监督推理前缀和工具调用，并加入纯提示锚定抑制依赖。
approach.en: A trace-conditioned RL surrogate evaluates prompt-only rollouts, annealed component-aware SFT supervises reasoning prefixes and tool calls, and prompt-only anchoring limits dependence.

system_design.zh: 训练环包含纯提示 rollout 生成器、仅训练可见的专家轨迹上下文、双目标优化器和锚定损失；部署环不携带专家轨迹。
system_design.en: Training includes prompt-only rollout generation, training-visible trace context, a dual-objective optimizer, and anchoring loss; deployment carries no expert trace.

key_results.zh: 在多轮工具、函数调用和长链任务上，特权轨迹共训稳定超过强 SFT 与 RL 基线，显示密集过程信号可在不泄露到 rollout 时发挥作用。
key_results.en: Across multi-turn tool, function-calling, and long-horizon tasks, privileged trace co-training consistently beats strong SFT and RL baselines without exposing traces during rollout.

limitations.zh: 方法仍依赖高质量专家轨迹及其组件对齐；训练时上下文与部署时缺失之间的残余依赖只由锚定缓解而非消除。
limitations.en: The method still requires high-quality component-aligned expert traces, and anchoring mitigates rather than eliminates dependence on training-only context.

notes.zh: 上述非空 evaluation 标签仅来自官方 arXiv 摘要；摘要未给出可安全转录的表格级数值、硬件与集群配置，相关细节仍待全文审计。
notes.en: The non-empty evaluation labels above come only from the official arXiv abstract; it provides no table-level numbers, hardware, or cluster configuration safe to transcribe, so those details await full-text audit.
